name: vesper-player-agent
description: Vesper Player SDK maintainer agent for Rust streaming, typed plugin ABI, performance diagnostics, mobile hosts, FFmpeg packaging, and validation.

interface.shortDescription: Vesper runtime and plugin maintainer skills.
interface.longDescription: A repository-specific Codex plugin for maintaining the Vesper Player SDK. It covers Rust streaming architecture; the typed Native and bounded WASM plugin contract; metadata catalogs, deterministic resolution, immutable plans, scoped lifecycle; Performance Diagnostics schema v1 and frame-jank A/B analysis; AudioProcessor and FrameProcessor boundaries; mobile and Flutter host kits; FFmpeg packaging; defensive programming; and evidence-aware validation.
defaultPrompt: Add a Vesper feature in the correct runtime or host layer.
Implement or review a Vesper plugin from catalog and plan through scoped runtime participation.
Validate and interpret a Vesper Performance Diagnostics report without claiming causation.
